description:
Job Title: BizTalk Developer 
 Job Duration: 6 Months Contract 
 Address: Frisco, TX 
 Interview Method: Phone then In Person 
 
 Job Description: 
 Architect, Design and Develop complex B2B Integrations and Orchestrations using BizTalk, CEP (Complex Event Processing) and SOAP/WSDL. 
 Document and present the architecture and design to peer group. 
 Work with Analyst to understand systems and integration requirements. 
 Assist QA team in explaining the integration mechanisms and approach. 
 Assist in deploying highly scalable BizTalk Cluster. 
 
 Essential skills: 
 Minimum 5 years of development/architecture experience for a mid to large size organization. 
 Minimum 3 years’ experience with the following: 
 o Microsoft BizTalk Server, including orchestrations, maps, pipelines, port configuration, XSLT, XML, XSD, as well as performance and scalability turning 
 o .Net Application Development 
 o Microsoft SQL Server and WCF SQL Adapter, including data design and optimization, stored procedures, cursors, XML queries, indexing, locking and relationships 
 o Solution-based architecture, design and estimation. 
 Experience with the implementation of business-to-business interfaces and service-oriented architecture preferred, especially with Saleforce.com. 
 Experience with the implementation of an enterprise service bus (ESB) preferred. 
 Excellent problem solving and debugging skills required. 
 Experience using online community resources to research technical solutions. 
 Ability to deliver quality deliverables against specified timelines. 
 Banking industry knowledge a definite plus. 
 Knowledge and/or experience with Agile Scrum a plus. 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems or other related field. 
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
